title: Pin every external action to a full SHA and harden workflow steps
summary: Rewrites every non-local `uses:` in `.github/workflows/*.yml` to `@<40-hex> # v<semver>`, sets `persist-credentials: false` on every checkout, adds top-level `permissions: contents: read` and `defaults.run.shell: bash` to every workflow, starts every multi-line `run:` with `set -Eeuo pipefail`, moves untrusted expressions out of `run:` into `env:`, replaces `secrets: inherit` with the explicit `MONOREPO_SPLIT_TOKEN` (declared in `split.yml` `workflow_call.secrets`), runs the split job in environment `release`, moves `dependabot-auto-merge.yml` writes to job level and removes the `|| true` in `bench.yml`.
why: P0-B (A02): floating tags let a compromised upstream action run with the release token; `secrets: inherit` passes every secret to the split. Risks: an annotated tag SHA instead of its commit SHA breaks the action; `persist-credentials: false` breaks a step that pushes with the checkout token (none should: the split action uses `GITHUB_TOKEN` env from `MONOREPO_SPLIT_TOKEN`); `set -u` breaks scripts that read unset variables; `environment: release` makes the split wait for approval once P4.5 configures it (intended).

include: All 14 workflow files of knowledge/supply-chain#inventory; SHAs resolved per knowledge/execution#conventions item 6, same major as today
`split.yml`: `on.workflow_call.secrets.MONOREPO_SPLIT_TOKEN.required: true`; job `split` gets `environment: release`; the `Require package publishing configuration` step keeps its fail-closed check
`dependabot-auto-merge.yml`: top-level `permissions: contents: read`, job-level `contents: write`, `pull-requests: write`
`pr-check.yml`, `mutation.yml`: top-level `permissions: contents: read`; job-level writes only per knowledge/supply-chain#permissions
`tests/Arch/ReleaseWorkflowTest.php`: adjust only assertions that encode `secrets: inherit` or unpinned refs; no assertion weakened
exclude: Major version bumps (separate Dependabot PRs later)

reads.why: Branch, commits, owner WIP, frozen-contract stop rule, owner gates, evidence
Allowed job-level writes, split secret contract
Rules W1–W10 the result must already satisfy (P1.6 enforces them)

rules: One commit per concern is fine (pins; credentials/permissions/shell; split secret), all before P1.3.

Never pin to a branch or a SHA you did not resolve from the release tag through gh api in this session; record `action | tag | sha` in `plans/2026.10.17-№1-AZGUARD-FINAL-HARDENING/artifacts/evidence/P1.2/pins.md`.
guidance: Resolve: `gh api repos/actions/checkout/releases --jq '[.[]|select(.tag_name|startswith("v6."))][0].tag_name'` then `gh api repos/actions/checkout/git/ref/tags/<tag> --jq .object` (type `tag` → `gh api repos/actions/checkout/git/tags/<sha> --jq .object.sha`). For `github/codeql-action/init` and `/analyze` use the same repo SHA. `symplify/monorepo-split-github-action@v2.4.5` is already an exact tag: pin its commit. Expressions in `with:` and `env:` are fine; W10 concerns only `run:`.

validation.cmd: python3 -c 'import yaml,glob,sys; bad=[(f,j,s.get("name")) for f in glob.glob(".github/workflows/*.yml") for j,v in (yaml.safe_load(open(f)).get("jobs") or {}).items() for s in v.get("steps",[]) if str(s.get("uses","")).startswith("actions/checkout@") and (s.get("with") or {}).get("persist-credentials") is not False]; print(bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)'

validation.procedure: Push per knowledge/execution#ci-evidence (gate CI-PUSH); ci-runs check for Tests, Static Analysis, Code Style, Compatibility, Zizmor, CodeQL
